name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Customer Success Manager role. Being the first human a new customer talks to, and getting them to first value before they drift, is the work I like most. At Wix I onboarded 25+ small businesses a month, aiming to launch each one on the first call, while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets. At Birdeye I managed 15 to 20 reseller partners and retained all but one by watching usage data and stepping in on adoption gaps early.

Your role leans on education and engagement, and that's where I've put a lot of my own time. I've published 18 articles explaining CRM, automation, and AI search in plain language for non-technical owners, run product workshops for client teams, and built automated onboarding and lifecycle sequences that keep new users moving. I also ran a free-offer acquisition motion for my own practice, so I've seen up close how a self-serve user decides to pay.

My experience is more than the posting asks for, and that's deliberate: I want to do this work, for customers whose mission I care about. I haven't worked for a nonprofit, but helping immigrant and refugee communities is a personal commitment of mine, and nonprofits doing that work run on exactly the kind of tools Donorbox builds. I'd welcome a conversation.
